text.tspan: Phase 1 · reusable, editable and token-bound. Main components live to the right; this frame contains review instances.
Enter or Space activates. Focus ring is visible. Loading prevents duplicate submission; failure retains input and offers Retry.
Label gap 6 px; control 38 px; body 13/20; field grid gap 24 px. Helper and error messages stay adjacent to their field.
Section status / not a repair outcome
Done = all relevant fields complete. In progress = partial information with core fields present. Pending = important fields missing. Not started = no activity.
No dashed frame. Hover or keyboard focus highlights only target fields. Badge identifies capability, not provenance. Errors preserve current values.
Checkboxes select eligible free parts only. Confirmed GSPN order composition is locked. Editable cells retain field-level keyboard focus.
Enter or Space toggles; aria-expanded follows state. Done sections close on initial page load only. Manual expansion remains respected during editing.

One Save changes action persists editable fields. Discard restores the last saved values. Confirm outcome is a separate deliberate action that locks the repair.
Action messages explain what happened and what to do next. Loading and errors never clear the form.
